An occasional drink while taking doxycycline is unlikely to cause severe reactions for most healthy adults, though ` [Highlight start] avoiding alcohol until you finish treatment is generally recommended [Highlight end] ` . Unlike antibiotics such as metronidazole, doxycycline does not cause a severe disulfiram-like reaction with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPLYGGEjfuU_S2_vuj2XwIdu8tzwbg3PTD0C591SlCijqKeFXAz2-REsGafx8gYF7DjG7yjWIv0xhFpOOJuWOXjDLThmz3fE_qGk1Ldt-tGPb6Ph6YRQ09rvoFDaPx8Npyz2ZfEFLZtl_sC4vS9lyDA-NjuIj)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-_zTRx1NExirhk5mP2j1uqIjuT8MeTlbXZZ89tyKB861ehEDSn2b6Fqg-VarnveEnLp2W4QyeTiT7sUYG2nsvH56A2Ww6xiUfUlUh9_gceIXLZhNGMRHcMtxAmqm_dmdhRRdbRm9d-pHcVj61lJui53hNMpfpTFTJT3GvBkWqGYgOa3oXpGI93UV8womd_x7Qqk)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF147CAgI8hmVTe_se5xFE0siR17ztzmfTaDz9zPe1iLQY2nokOTcIFWeW-m_HFqSbGWgNcD2YAwkKrnXmnjdDt13COAasH6JCo7BY5VHkHjJ2jf6eDdG4cWGa54L35h9kJu8tYbTTK0zHtzns4Alvn9kMnpPGp6mk02te9A)

### Potential Side Effects

Mixing alcohol and doxycycline can cause overlapping or worsened side effects, especially with heavier drinking:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)

- **Digestive upset:** Nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea, or esophageal irritation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXt38zBoPDG8uvVSK_ozKCNbvCUWuakwER-B0MPv-jYNlafvkar3ey5uDCKkb9t43VvRese1747O-a4rfHTX8iFPB72ULCGmI_ERh_oZhjDwpRQkErY2874nZRzmZ9V6it_wLjausGl0pw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)
- **Neurological effects:** Dizziness, drowsiness, or headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF10jFR0uDf6y94L8YonZiL3UpCqICHx7FT0hWrbkkH9FH7G_agz5BAfrdchzCi-blEHX7Dviuo4u0iJoWPU5TYMrfxSOxJ9zuAHSAxb4SFytQ55rh_2QA7FIBoFUbb05sbGHxXZBtgk3SZCxkkd6NpP2uFtFTy-Mp8WZEec39YfoYjLaewtAvnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1_Mkw4QMz32RFMzj66wcqQBITtJ3fBAhWoPVbsM9Z-9Bi6OpiFO66pDIbwct_U9lbJoq2fWIHMj4g6hAbbsORbyQYU6srN9CQ09QEp_jX2XtLdNkc9Yzx__zkQ7-GKn9xhe8n4DPUyYTS1dWS_t9vhWhtkg6C2VRzR824Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXt38zBoPDG8uvVSK_ozKCNbvCUWuakwER-B0MPv-jYNlafvkar3ey5uDCKkb9t43VvRese1747O-a4rfHTX8iFPB72ULCGmI_ERh_oZhjDwpRQkErY2874nZRzmZ9V6it_wLjausGl0pw)
- **Liver strain:** Both alcohol and tetracyclines can affect the liver, increasing risk if you have existing liver issues or drink heavily.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXt38zBoPDG8uvVSK_ozKCNbvCUWuakwER-B0MPv-jYNlafvkar3ey5uDCKkb9t43VvRese1747O-a4rfHTX8iFPB72ULCGmI_ERh_oZhjDwpRQkErY2874nZRzmZ9V6it_wLjausGl0pw)

### Effects on Effectiveness, Half-Life, and Elimination

- **Effectiveness:** Moderate drinking usually does not reduce how well doxycycline works. Heavy or chronic drinking can lower blood levels of the antibiotic and weaken your immune response, potentially slowing recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPLYGGEjfuU_S2_vuj2XwIdu8tzwbg3PTD0C591SlCijqKeFXAz2-REsGafx8gYF7DjG7yjWIv0xhFpOOJuWOXjDLThmz3fE_qGk1Ldt-tGPb6Ph6YRQ09rvoFDaPx8Npyz2ZfEFLZtl_sC4vS9lyDA-NjuIj)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjAEBxCJF10jFR0uDf6y94L8YonZiL3UpCqICHx7FT0hWrbkkH9FH7G_agz5BAfrdchzCi-blEHX7Dviuo4u0iJoWPU5TYMrfxSOxJ9zuAHSAxb4SFytQ55rh_2QA7FIBoFUbb05sbGHxXZBtgk3SZCxkkd6NpP2uFtFTy-Mp8WZEec39YfoYjLaewtAvnA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)
- **Half-life and elimination:** Doxycycline has a half-life of roughly 16 to 22 hours and takes about 4 to 5 days to clear from the body. Heavy or chronic alcohol use can shorten its half-life and speed up clearance, reducing how long it stays active in your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF175dpIUF9R8ywoBho1X5hGJywAX50Igc6tHEfmaC7DL9fWD2jM_FxWofNFBwfalLypKR0e4eWcoNdSeD3xKJyNhvK-JD5y07pNmaGeC4UhQQVDGJ1U4rPElRVJBccXhqTTeTIPYHyF1gCb5sDtlijJ6Q1RimYPcsQEHVqlEuwHQ8jQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPLYGGEjfuU_S2_vuj2XwIdu8tzwbg3PTD0C591SlCijqKeFXAz2-REsGafx8gYF7DjG7yjWIv0xhFpOOJuWOXjDLThmz3fE_qGk1Ldt-tGPb6Ph6YRQ09rvoFDaPx8Npyz2ZfEFLZtl_sC4vS9lyDA-NjuIj)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXt38zBoPDG8uvVSK_ozKCNbvCUWuakwER-B0MPv-jYNlafvkar3ey5uDCKkb9t43VvRese1747O-a4rfHTX8iFPB72ULCGmI_ERh_oZhjDwpRQkErY2874nZRzmZ9V6it_wLjausGl0pw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)

### Waiting After Stopping Doxycycline

- You can generally wait until you finish your course and feel recovered from your infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPLYGGEjfuU_S2_vuj2XwIdu8tzwbg3PTD0C591SlCijqKeFXAz2-REsGafx8gYF7DjG7yjWIv0xhFpOOJuWOXjDLThmz3fE_qGk1Ldt-tGPb6Ph6YRQ09rvoFDaPx8Npyz2ZfEFLZtl_sC4vS9lyDA-NjuIj)
- Because doxycycline takes about 16 to 22 hours per half-life and roughly 4 to 5 days to clear completely, waiting 48 hours or until your course ends helps minimize lingering side effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXPLYGGEjfuU_S2_vuj2XwIdu8tzwbg3PTD0C591SlCijqKeFXAz2-REsGafx8gYF7DjG7yjWIv0xhFpOOJuWOXjDLThmz3fE_qGk1Ldt-tGPb6Ph6YRQ09rvoFDaPx8Npyz2ZfEFLZtl_sC4vS9lyDA-NjuIj)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXsnJQN9djlDr1bgfhj89caylclAp_Lz0dRapMNd1QldQXf2VTlj0Cqc226ZMTzh4z3KCvJwwE4oaO4Gb9LorH0_moTPZt3fSsVVwXOCIa_6VJlOCqYshmuu3Vroru2ZoPxlIiKuF5YFE0nQXDxkI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXt38zBoPDG8uvVSK_ozKCNbvCUWuakwER-B0MPv-jYNlafvkar3ey5uDCKkb9t43VvRese1747O-a4rfHTX8iFPB72ULCGmI_ERh_oZhjDwpRQkErY2874nZRzmZ9V6it_wLjausGl0pw)

For more details on safe spacing and when to speak with a prescriber, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx) or [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-_zTRx1NExirhk5mP2j1uqIjuT8MeTlbXZZ89tyKB861ehEDSn2b6Fqg-VarnveEnLp2W4QyeTiT7sUYG2nsvH56A2Ww6xiUfUlUh9_gceIXLZhNGMRHcMtxAmqm_dmdhRRdbRm9d-pHcVj61lJui53hNMpfpTFTJT3GvBkWqGYgOa3oXpGI93UV8womd_x7Qqk) . If you want broader context on antibiotic-alcohol interactions, review [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIV_lg0v2VDbFT8gGSf_euELlGlNvx3FjRh-0RCSuu1UUOMQm8Bnb-vgw6Z_yoxLphn6w9oUDxcSded9xq-zWRX1A3zGaCkNYWtSeUZJhUvHrVyIe4zRs1W7T4_Zorl_tIxGA0m3AZg).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXc7IjJXPFE8M7kyxbRmJ-H_OwK2SQ4mhtWxqeo-y6X9UV2KXvjW8LL-KhrkjOwDkASis1XwiPpWOBw3tCCVPzYDffMFbLkw4qVMU2juBJDf7DWw3f63nqwlEbJ4QC008KHjLyLhsRHWheysRu8Wdx)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-_zTRx1NExirhk5mP2j1uqIjuT8MeTlbXZZ89tyKB861ehEDSn2b6Fqg-VarnveEnLp2W4QyeTiT7sUYG2nsvH56A2Ww6xiUfUlUh9_gceIXLZhNGMRHcMtxAmqm_dmdhRRdbRm9d-pHcVj61lJui53hNMpfpTFTJT3GvBkWqGYgOa3oXpGI93UV8womd_x7Qqk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXIV_lg0v2VDbFT8gGSf_euELlGlNvx3FjRh-0RCSuu1UUOMQm8Bnb-vgw6Z_yoxLphn6w9oUDxcSded9xq-zWRX1A3zGaCkNYWtSeUZJhUvHrVyIe4zRs1W7T4_Zorl_tIxGA0m3AZg)If you'd like more tailored information, share:

- **How much** you plan to drink or if you already had a drink
- **What condition** you're taking doxycycline for
- Any **liver history** or **side effects** you're noticing

items.title: Effects on Effectiveness, Half-Life, and Elimination
items.text: Effectiveness: Moderate drinking usually does not reduce how well doxycycline works. Heavy or chronic drinking can lower blood levels of the antibiotic and weaken your immune response, potentially slowing recovery. Half-life and elimination: Doxycycline has a half-life of roughly 16 to 22 hours and takes about 4 to 5 days to clear from the body. Heavy or chronic alcohol use can shorten its half-life and speed up clearance, reducing how long it stays active in your system.

items.title: Waiting After Stopping Doxycycline
items.text: You can generally wait until you finish your course and feel recovered from your infection. Because doxycycline takes about 16 to 22 hours per half-life and roughly 4 to 5 days to clear completely, waiting 48 hours or until your course ends helps minimize lingering side effects.
